name: @bump-sh/agent-playground
description: Interactive configurator for @bump-sh/agent-widget — tweak options, see the widget live, copy the code.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts src/frame.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --minify --outdir=dist --alias:@bump-sh/agent-widget=../agent-widget/src/index.ts --alias:@bump-sh/agent-conversation=../agent-conversation/src/index.ts && cp index.html frame.html dist/
scripts.dev: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html frame.html dist/ && esbuild src/main.ts src/frame.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outdir=dist --servedir=dist --watch=forever --alias:@bump-sh/agent-widget=../agent-widget/src/index.ts --alias:@bump-sh/agent-conversation=../agent-conversation/src/index.ts
